theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_to_cusp_count_factorization
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ModularCurve.cuspCount N = N.primeFactors.prod (fun p => (Finset.range (N.factorization p + 1)).sum (fun j => Nat.totient (p ^ min j (N.factorization p - j))))
